extra.reason: Fixed. Registry now auto-refreshes on AU-folder mtime change (primary) with a 24h TTL backstop; new 'Checked <when> · Rescan' line in the plugin rail gives a manual escape hatch. Rescan preserves the loaded registry while running and on failure. Verified live: aged cache 5 entries -> app relaunch -> 269 entries, single scan.

Implemented as an explicit engine preference (View → Search With: Google/DuckDuckGo/Bing/Kagi/Brave/Ecosia), persisted and synced to the native menu checkmark. Rejected x-web-search:// after checking on this Mac: it has no registered handler at all, and it bypasses browser routers (default https handler here is Finicky), so it would ignore the user's browser choice rather than honour it.

Copy fingerprint / Search the web (plus new Copy name) extracted into a shared PluginRowActions used by both project and Library rollup rows. Library row's <details>/<summary> replaced with a button + aria-expanded so row actions no longer toggle the disclosure; covered by a regression test.

Plug-in name is now a button: clipped to one line by default, unclamps to full wrap on click/Enter, carries the full name as title, and reveals Copy name / Copy fingerprint / Search the web. Keeps rows one line tall by default.
